description: Static phrase bank for the drag-and-drop sentence game 'Quebra-Cabeça de Frases'. No dialogues, no LLM at runtime.

pipeline.authoringFormat: Lean: each phrase has { id, nivel, tier, pt, en?, es?, words:[{palavra, pt, dificil?}], distratores:[hanzi string, max 2] }. Per-character pinyin is filled by the build script.
pipeline.builder: web/scripts/build-phrase-game-data.mjs (uses pinyin-pro; cross-checks tier vs vocabulario/vocab-basico.json hsk1 flag)

nivel.description: Authoring hint; pool selection uses token count + tier.

tier.description: Iniciante uses hsk1 only; Básico uses the full basic lexicon.

en.description: Optional English prompt (fallback chain locale → pt).

tokens.description: Ordered word pieces for the game.

dificil.description: HSK2 / hard word — eligible for difficult-word hints.

distratores.description: Distractor candidates — NEVER more than 2. Must not compose another valid sentence with the answer tokens.

4.pieces: partial split (1-2 multi-char words into hanzi); ~3 of 10 phrases get 1 extra distractor

5.pieces: full split (every token into individual hanzi); every phrase gets 1-2 distractors

rules: No dialogues (no speaker names, no A：B： format).
Single standalone, grammatical sentence per entry.
Vocabulary within the basic/intermediate course lexicon.
Distractors must not compose another valid sentence with the answer tokens.
Never more than 2 distractor pieces on any phrase, under any setting.
